note: Review decisions on the public demo were made by the Sieve maintainers after reading the evidence each finding shows. They demonstrate the review workflow; they are not generated.

decisions.comment: Confirmed. PUT /configs/<name> passes the request body to yaml.load(..., Loader=FullLoader). Upgrade PyYAML to 5.4+ and switch to yaml.safe_load.
Same call site as CVE-2020-14343: untrusted upload bodies reach FullLoader.
Override. The path goes through app.run() under `if __name__ == "__main__"`, which only starts the local development server. Production runs the app under a WSGI server with the debugger disabled.
Accepted. Pillow is still pinned in requirements.txt but nothing imports it. Removing the pin is tracked separately.
